newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Shantou to build one bln yuan toll bridge.
newsitem.headline: China's Shantou to build one bln yuan toll bridge.

text.p: China's southern city of Shantou plans to build a one billion yuan bridge in a joint venture with a Hong Kong investment company, the Chinese construction firm said on Tuesday.
The 2,861-metre bridge in the city in Guangdong province would be open to traffic in late 1998, an official of the Jueshi Bridge Construction Co said.
The Bondecko Investment Co Ltd (Hong Kong) would take a 70 percent stake in the company that would build and operate the toll bridge for 26 years, the official said.
The bridge would be linked to a road that stretches northeastward to reach Fuzhou, capital of Fujian province.
